# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-docs.sh from `corral <cmd> --help`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated from `corral 0.4.0`. Every command also accepts
`--root <ROOT>` (the directory containing `.corral/`; default: discovered from the current directory).

```text
Project management control plane for agentic coding, inside herdr

Usage: corral [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  mode            Select Assist or explicitly confirm scoped Autopilot for this workspace
  inbox           Inspect and durably manage agent inbox messages without delivering them
  attention       Inspect current task conditions and progress without changing state
  agent           Pi-native agent host: authenticated host calls, launch, install and recovery
  question        Triage Pi-native agent questions by key and revision: list, show, answer, escalate, cancel, deadline
  automation      Preview, explicitly confirm, or inspect finite operating authority
  selection       Read current selection guidance or save a validated Auto receipt; JSON output
  setup           Review and apply owner-approved profile setup; JSON output by default
  digest          Generate and pin a deterministic digest of recent outcomes and cost/time totals
  revert          Revert a task's exact landed commits on base and reopen it in Backlog; never push
  review-sprint   Build and pin a sprint review from events, artifacts and recorded usage
  idea            Record a reasoned idea disposition; owner ideas require explicit consent
  lessons         Inspect project lessons, distill history, pin rules or delete them
  plan            Submit, review and approve implementation plans independently of code review
  build-identity  Print the immutable landed identity embedded by a post-land install
  hooks           Inspect, reconcile and retry durable project post-land operations
  run             Persist run progress, checkpoints, waits, decisions and resume receipts
  queue           Authorize, pause, and inspect the coding dispatch queue
  wait            Wait for the first matching event, starting at EOF by default (timeout exits 124)
  up              Start or attach the board; also the default when no command is given
  doctor          Check the terminal engine and workspace setup
  init            Create .corral/ in --root or the current directory
  pricing         Inspect coverage of API-equivalent model prices
  import          Import a Markdown plan as a tracker and dependent child tasks
  stats           Outcome evidence grouped by profile (default), model, kind, project, task, size, mode or day
  new             Create a task and print its id
  list            List tasks (done/dropped hidden unless --all; --done lists finished tasks, newest first)
  search          Search tasks or indexed artifact, specification and review content
  log             Show one task's lifecycle timeline, oldest first
  show            Show one task
  comment         Append a comment to a task, optionally sending it to the agent
  move            Move a task to another status
  edit            Open the task file in $EDITOR
  route           Explain the implementer and reviewer mapping without starting a run
  dispatch        Start an agent run for a task
  reply           Send a reply to the task's agent
  unstick         Terminate a stuck foreign foreground process after confirmation, then retry the pending reply
  done            Mark the run finished and move the task to Review
  criteria        Manage explicit owner-reviewed criterion manifests
  evidence        Record and inspect criterion-linked worker assertions
  gate            Run the review gate commands in the current run's worktree (in a herdr pane)
  review-run      Start an independent review of the current run (a reviewer profile in its own pane, or the PM)
  verdict         Record a review verdict on the current run
  dashboard       Configure recurring living-dashboard report tasks
  artifact        Manage artifacts
  pin             Pin a task (T-042) or artifact (T-042:R1:<file>) so it is one step away
  unpin           Remove a pin (by ref or pin number)
  pins            List pins in order
  open            Open a pin (number or ref) or any task/artifact ref with its viewer: [viewers], else $CORRAL_OPENER, else terminal-browser for HTML inside herdr, else the system opener (WSL-aware)
  review          Show the review summary of a task
  approve         Merge the run and mark the task Done
  changes         Request changes on a task in Review
  retry           Start a fresh run for a task
  discard         Discard the current run and drop the task
  jump            Focus the task's herdr pane
  sync            Reconcile tasks with herdr and advance the review autopilot (--watch: keep syncing every 2 s, headless)
  autopilot       Compatibility alias: shared status, workspace pause, or guidance for scoped activation
  hook            herdr plugin event hook: run sync once, always exit 0
  bind-session    Bind legacy pane ownership using verified launch or plugin-registration evidence
  pm              Open the PM pane, or inspect the next PM decision
  focus-board     Go back to this workspace's board pane, opening one only if none is running (the back-to-board key)
  board           Open the board TUI
  capture         Open the capture popup
  artifacts       Open the artifact finder
  settings        Open the settings screen
  harness         Installed agent harnesses, their versions and models
  plugin          Manage the herdr plugin
  skill           Print the corral agent skill (SKILL.md), or install it for your agents
  config          Read, change and check layered user and workspace configuration
  ext             Run or list external `corral-ext-<name>` commands found on PATH
  help            Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
  -V, --version      Print version
```

## `corral mode`

```text
Select Assist or explicitly confirm scoped Autopilot for this workspace

Usage: corral mode [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  status     Read effective mode, finite scope, authority, blockers and shared progress
  assist     Withdraw automatic authority without stopping running work
  autopilot  Preview a finite scope; grant only after exact owner confirmation
  pause      Stop new automatic actions without interrupting agents or receipt collection
  resume     Resume the existing matching grant; never expands or refreshes its scope
  turbo      Land, accept plans and repair without owner stops or round limits until `--off`
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral mode status`

```text
Read effective mode, finite scope, authority, blockers and shared progress

Usage: corral mode status [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --json         
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

```text
Usage: corral mode assist [OPTIONS]

      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral mode autopilot`

```text
Preview a finite scope; grant only after exact owner confirmation

Usage: corral mode autopilot [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --project <PROJECTS>
          Snapshot current Ready/Backlog tasks in these projects (with --include-new: all unfinished and future tasks)
      --root <ROOT>
          Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --include-new
          Also cover tasks filed later in the --project projects; the grant then expires
      --expires-after-days <EXPIRES_AFTER_DAYS>
          Days after confirmation when a grant covering new tasks ends (default 7, max 365)
      --max-new-tasks <MAX_NEW_TASKS>
          Most tasks filed after confirmation that the grant covers
      --task <TASKS>
          
      --exclude <EXCLUSIONS>
          
      --plan-scope <PLAN_SCOPES>
          Exact reviewed plan scope: TASK:LABEL (repeatable)
      --dispatch
          Delegate dispatch (also required for automatic gate/review/repair)
      --accept
          Delegate landing subject to existing owner exceptions and verification
      --plan-accept
          
      --aggregate-accept
          Delegate final tracker Plan acceptance; still requires an independent aggregate review
      --confirm <CONFIRM>
          Confirm the exact previously displayed preview identity (also noninteractively)
      --json
          Print the preview as JSON; without --confirm this never grants authority
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## `corral inbox`

```text
Inspect and durably manage agent inbox messages without delivering them

Usage: corral inbox [OPTIONS]
       corral inbox <COMMAND>

Commands:
  show           Show the complete message, receipts, and effect state
  flush          Request that held information be flushed by the delivery service
  retry          Re-post a terminal message whose evidence proves it never arrived, with a new id
  inspect-retry  Inspect exact-recipient retry evidence without posting or certifying a later retry
  index-owner    Advance bounded legacy owner identity indexing (not retry-history certification)
  recover        Record the owner's recovery decision for an open envelope
  mark           Record manual observation or cancellation
  help           Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --for <RECIPIENT>  Restrict the list to one recipient key
      --root <ROOT>      Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --json             
      --all              Include observed and terminal messages
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## `corral attention`

```text
Inspect current task conditions and progress without changing state

Usage: corral attention [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  list    List the current read-only attention assessment (the default)
  attend  Record handling without answering, moving or authorizing the task
  park    Stop new execution while retaining explicit, checkable resume conditions
  unpark  Remove exactly the current park; never lifts a dispatch hold
  stats   Report PM-attention metrics from retained lifecycle facts over a window
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>        Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --json               Print the versioned assessment, including tasks without conditions
      --all                Include Done and Dropped tasks
      --project <PROJECT>  Include only tasks with this exact project name
  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `corral agent`

```text
Pi-native agent host: authenticated host calls, launch, install and recovery

Usage: corral agent [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  call     Run one Pi-native host request: a JSON envelope on stdin, one JSON receipt on stdout
  launch   Start the Pi-native host in this pane from a one-shot bootstrap (run by corral)
  install  Install the Pi-native host assets into the user data directory
  login    Provision the corral-owned Pi credentials with one interactive owner login
  doctor   Report the Bun runtime, installed assets, GO manifest, roles and credential presence
  state    Show a Pi-native binding: generations, host health, receipts, questions and turns
  cancel   Cancel a Pi-native host turn; the run, its questions and receipts stay live
  resume   Fence a lost Pi-native generation and start the next one in the same pane
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral agent call`

```text
Run one Pi-native host request: a JSON envelope on stdin, one JSON receipt on stdout

Usage: corral agent call [OPTIONS] --op <OP>

Options:
      --op <OP>      Enumerated v1 operation; must equal the envelope's op [possible values: hello, event, receipt_lookup, ask, withdraw, wait, progress, checkpoint, evidence, artifact, gate, done, verdict, question_answer, question_escalate, question_cancel, reply, comment, capture, read_brief, read_next, read_show, read_list, read_search, read_route, read_artifacts, read_lessons]
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral agent launch`

```text
Start the Pi-native host in this pane from a one-shot bootstrap (run by corral)

Usage: corral agent launch [OPTIONS] --bootstrap <BOOTSTRAP>

Options:
      --bootstrap <BOOTSTRAP>  One-shot bootstrap file written by dispatch, review-run, pm open or resume
      --root <ROOT>            Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --assets <ASSETS>        Asset directory; a fixture installation is accepted only through [agent] assets_dir
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

### `corral agent install`

```text
Install the Pi-native host assets into the user data directory

Usage: corral agent install [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --from <FROM>  Package directory, or a compiled corral-pi-host, to install from (default: the corral-pi-host beside this corral, else this build's checkout)
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --json         
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral agent cancel`

```text
Cancel a Pi-native host turn; the run, its questions and receipts stay live

Usage: corral agent cancel [OPTIONS] [TASK]

Arguments:
  [TASK]  Task of the worker run or review child

Options:
      --root <ROOT>      Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --run <RUN>        Run ID (default: the task's current run)
      --review <REVIEW>  Review child ID of the run (default: the worker run itself)
      --pm               The bound Pi-native PM instead of a task
      --turn <TURN>      Turn sequence to cancel (default: the current turn)
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### `corral agent resume`

```text
Fence a lost Pi-native generation and start the next one in the same pane

Usage: corral agent resume [OPTIONS] [TASK]

Arguments:
  [TASK]  Task of the worker run or review child

Options:
      --root <ROOT>      Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --run <RUN>        Run ID (default: the task's current run)
      --review <REVIEW>  Review child ID of the run (default: the worker run itself)
      --pm               The bound Pi-native PM instead of a task
      --replace          Replace a host that is still alive after verifying its pid, start time and command
  -h, --help             Print help
```

## `corral question`

```text
Triage Pi-native agent questions by key and revision: list, show, answer, escalate, cancel, deadline

Usage: corral question [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  list      List Pi-native agent questions; pending ones (open or escalated) by default
  show      Show one question with its effective state, triage, answer and deadline
  answer    Answer at the current revision; a PM answer needs --basis refs and --scope-note
  escalate  Escalate an open question to the owner, optionally reclassifying it upward
  cancel    Cancel a pending question with a reason
  deadline  Owner only: expire the question at --at with --instruction unless its revision changes first
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral question list`

```text
List Pi-native agent questions; pending ones (open or escalated) by default

Usage: corral question list [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --task <TASK>  Only this task's questions
      --all          Include answered, expired, withdrawn and cancelled questions
      --json         
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral question show`

```text
Show one question with its effective state, triage, answer and deadline

Usage: corral question show [OPTIONS] <KEY>

Arguments:
  <KEY>  Question key <task>/<run>[/<review-child>]/Q<n>

Options:
      --json         
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

### `corral question answer`

```text
Answer at the current revision; a PM answer needs --basis refs and --scope-note

Usage: corral question answer [OPTIONS] --rev <REV> --text <TEXT> <KEY>

Arguments:
  <KEY>  

Options:
      --rev <REV>                The question's current revision; a stale revision is refused
      --root <ROOT>              Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --text <TEXT>              
      --option <OPTION>          One of the question's options
      --basis <BASIS>            Canonical basis ref (repeatable): spec:<task>@<revision>, plan:<task>@<plan>, decision:<task>@<plan>#<n>, decision:<task>/<run>/<id> or comment:<task>#<n>
      --scope-note <SCOPE_NOTE>  How the answer stays inside the approved write scope and acceptance
      --owner                    Answer as the owner: any pending question, or supersede an answer
      --json                     
  -h, --help                     Print help
```

```text
Escalate an open question to the owner, optionally reclassifying it upward

  <KEY>  

Options:

      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --note <NOTE>  
      --kind <KIND>  New kind; reclassification goes upward only [possible values: clarification, technical-choice, permission, owner-only]
      --json         
  -h, --help         Print help
```

```text
Cancel a pending question with a reason

Arguments:
  <KEY>  

Options:
      --rev <REV>        
      --root <ROOT>      Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir

      --json             
  -h, --help             Print help
```

### `corral question deadline`

```text
Owner only: expire the question at --at with --instruction unless its revision changes first

Usage: corral question deadline [OPTIONS] --rev <REV> --at <AT> --instruction <INSTRUCTION> <KEY>

Arguments:
  <KEY>  

Options:
      --rev <REV>                  
      --root <ROOT>                Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --at <AT>                    RFC 3339 timestamp
      --instruction <INSTRUCTION>  Delivered to the agent as the owner_deadline answer
      --json                       
  -h, --help                       Print help
```


```text
Options:
      --project <PROJECTS>
          Snapshot current Ready/Backlog tasks in these projects (with --include-new: all unfinished and future tasks)
      --root <ROOT>
          Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --include-new
          Also cover tasks filed later in the --project projects; the grant then expires
      --expires-after-days <EXPIRES_AFTER_DAYS>
          Days after confirmation when a grant covering new tasks ends (default 7, max 365)
      --max-new-tasks <MAX_NEW_TASKS>
          Most tasks filed after confirmation that the grant covers
      --task <TASKS>
          
      --exclude <EXCLUSIONS>
          
      --plan-scope <PLAN_SCOPES>
          Exact reviewed plan scope: TASK:LABEL (repeatable)
      --dispatch
          Delegate dispatch (also required for automatic gate/review/repair)
      --accept
          Delegate landing subject to existing owner exceptions and verification
      --plan-accept
          
      --aggregate-accept
          Delegate final tracker Plan acceptance; still requires an independent aggregate review
      --digest <DIGEST>
          
  -h, --help
          Print help
```


## `corral plan`

```text
Submit, review and approve implementation plans independently of code review

Usage: corral plan [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  progress           Read tracker Plan readiness, target-qualified prerequisites and criterion coverage
  verify             Start an aggregate attempt and run the gate on the combined Plan candidate
  checkpoint         Run an advisory full gate on the Plan integration target head; never aggregate PASS
  evidence           Record an aggregate scenario observation (evidence JSON with run "aggregate")
  aggregate-review   Launch the configured independent reviewer on the current aggregate attempt
  aggregate-verdict  Record a launched aggregate reviewer's verdict; callbacks name their exact review
  accept             Accept the current aggregate attempt and land it once (owner by default)
  cancel             End a planner session while retaining submitted plans and review history
  submit             Snapshot a plan (YAML metadata + markdown) against the current task spec
  show               Inspect current and historical plan snapshots and verdicts
  review             Review a plan without starting implementation or taking a coding slot
  verdict            Record a plan-only verdict; callbacks must include their exact attempt
  member-gate        Amend a published integration-Plan member's gate (owner only, revision-guarded)
  add-member         Add an unstarted task to a tracker Plan's required members, e.g. a fix after a failed verify (owner only)
  move-member        Move an unstarted member, e.g. one held in Backlog, from one tracker Plan to another (owner only)
  policy             Set the task's plan requirement, or inherit workspace/project review policy
  help               Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

```text
      --after-offset <AFTER_OFFSET>  Resume immediately after this byte offset
```


## `corral stats`

```text
Outcome evidence grouped by profile (default), model, kind, project, task, size, mode or day

Usage: corral stats [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>
          Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir

      --storage
          Artifact storage totals per task and workspace, including limit warnings

      --by <BY>
          [default: profile]
          [possible values: profile, model, kind, project, task, size, mode, day]

      --since <SINCE>
          Include runs dispatched in the last N days, hours or weeks (e.g. 30d); with --gates, gates started since then or since an RFC 3339 timestamp

      --gates
          Gate report per cohort, tier and destination instead of run groups.
          
          A destination is <project>:<branch> (the Plan target branch, else the run's base).
          Counts every event inside --since/--until. A `gate` event closes the start with
          its identity.attempt, else its run's latest open start. Finished gates are pass,
          stale_result, invalid_receipts or command_failed. A gate is followed by a rebase when
          its run's next candidate_rebased, review_started, done, approved or gate_started is
          candidate_rebased. Behind at start: identity.integration_base is not an ancestor of
          identity.head in the task's project repository (Git errors count as unknown). Gates
          without a tier count as tier full. A landing or verdict inside the window is an
          outcome of every tier its run gated in (full when none), even before the window, so a
          promoted run's landing counts for its quick and full gates; totals count it once.
          Full-gate step
          seconds come from each gate log's `<== <step> <seconds>s` markers, else from timed
          command receipts. Carries are grouped by from_tier and to_tier (an event without them
          uses its tier, else its old/new identity's gate_tier binding, else full). Unlike measure_gates.py and measure_behind.py, a
          landing excludes keep_branch approvals, review rounds count verdict events, and
          behind-at-start hours use this pairing instead of the run's next gate event, with
          each gate checked in its own project's repository rather than one given repository.

      --until <UNTIL>
          With --gates, ignore events after this RFC 3339 timestamp

      --json
          

      --html
          Write a standalone HTML throughput report (requires --by mode)

      --out <OUT>
          With --html, write the report to this file instead of stdout

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

```text
Usage: corral artifact show [OPTIONS] <REFERENCE>

Arguments:
  <REFERENCE>  Artifact ref: T-042:R1:<file> (see corral artifact list)

Options:
      --raw            Print the decoded stored content unformatted
      --root <ROOT>    Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --lines <LINES>  Print an inclusive decoded source-line slice, e.g. 10-20
  -h, --help           Print help
```

## `corral retry`

```text
Start a fresh run for a task

Usage: corral retry [OPTIONS] <ID>

Arguments:
  <ID>  

Options:
      --root <ROOT>        Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --run <RUN>          Guard retry with the source run ID; requires its current checkpoint
      --profile <PROFILE>  Profile (harness + model + effort preset) for this run [alias: --agent]
      --model <MODEL>      Model override for this run

  -h, --help               Print help
```

## `corral pm`

```text
Open the PM pane, or inspect the next PM decision

Usage: corral pm [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  bench    Replay frozen events and score code policy or imported model decisions, offline
  next     Read authorized actions, pending decisions and waits without changing state
  brief    Compact board state and the next decision, without syncing
  act      Revalidate a revision-bound action and run the existing authorized executors
  present  Acknowledge presentation, not resolution, of an exact owner decision
  resolve  Record an actual owner answer to a workspace coordination decision
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

```text
Replay frozen events and score code policy or imported model decisions, offline

Usage: corral pm bench [OPTIONS] --events <EVENTS>

Options:
      --events <EVENTS>        
      --root <ROOT>            Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --cases <CASES>          Independently labelled snapshots supplementing events with log/transcript evidence
      --responses <RESPONSES>  Offline JSONL case_id/model/option/reported_cost_usd decisions
      --json                   
  -h, --help                   Print help
```

## `corral config`

```text
Read, change and check layered user and workspace configuration

Usage: corral config [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  diff      Show the latest recorded semantic config change, or all changes since a timestamp
  history   Show recorded config changes and invalid-config diagnostics in log order
  get       Print a setting by dotted key (e.g. limits.running, projects.app.path); defaults included
  set       Change a setting in place, keeping comments; refused when the result would be invalid
  validate  Check both config layers and list problems with their file (non-zero when invalid) [alias: check]
  path      Print the path of corral.toml
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>  Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
  -h, --help         Print help
```

```text
Show the latest recorded semantic config change, or all changes since a timestamp

Usage: corral config diff [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --root <ROOT>    Workspace root (the directory containing .corral/); default: discovered from the current dir
      --since <SINCE>  Include changes at or after this RFC3339 timestamp
      --json           Print an array of the original event records
  -h, --help           Print help
```

```text
  -h, --help         Print help
```
